notes: Stage 3 of the Continuity Programme, pre-registered with PROTOCOL.md before any trial. Three generations of model-written variants of the four hand-written strategies, selected by facts kept at hop 5 on two training documents, filtered once on a third, and validated ONCE on the sealed holdout against the best hand-written instruction. The search is drift-limited at six repeats and is registered as such: see the variance section of PROTOCOL.md. No runner exists yet; scripts/evolve_instructions.py, scripts/screen_instruction.py, an arbitrary-instruction entry point in handoff_bench.py and a cost_guard branch for this design must be written first.

validation.rule: A finalist that does not beat the control on this document does not reach the holdout, and the stage ends refused without spending the seal.

holdout.rule: One batch, one candidate chosen and hashed before the first call, applied once. A restart is permitted only if the batch aborts before any reader answer has been graded, and is recorded in PROTOCOL_DEVIATIONS.md before any score is seen.

screen.quarantine: A variant is discarded before it is run if it contains any content word from a quiz question, option or answer key of any of the three training documents, or any proper noun from those documents, outside the committed allow-list of generic handover vocabulary.
screen.feedback_to_mutator: Parent instruction texts and one fitness number each. No document, quiz, question, option, answer key, per-question grade or handoff is ever shown to the mutator.

decision.control_prior_basis: checklist at hop 5 in MEM-008 (91.3, 96.5, 92.4) and reproduced in a separate harness in MEM-010 (94.2, 95.8, 93.8). Headroom is 7 points against a registered threshold of 5. The prior cannot be verified before the holdout is spent.

power.paired_sd_basis: MEM-011 and MEM-012 ran an identical arm twice; the six-repeat estimates differ by +7.3, -2.8 and +8.3 per document, giving SE about 4.7 at six repeats and a per-chain paired SD of about 11.
power.note: check_headroom.py checks the point threshold against the control prior; it does not check the interval clause against the estimator's noise. At six repeats the 95% lower bound clause would require an observed mean above 8.8 points while the ceiling is 7.

decision.noise_source: Paired SD estimated at about 11 points from the duplicate anchored arm in PROP-EXP-MEM-011 and PROP-EXP-MEM-012, whose two six-repeat estimates differ by +7.3, -2.8 and +8.3 per document. It is an estimate from three paired differences and is itself uncertain; it is declared so the rule's interval clause can be checked at all, not because it is precise.

failure_policy.scope: applied separately within each generation, on the validation filter and on the holdout batch
